text_block_list.text:
One day after training, right around the 
time I was getting ready to go home—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Look. The stars are so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The breeze is cool and refreshing, and 
there's nobody else on the track."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I ran just a little 
longer...?
choice_data_list: Dorm curfew is coming up soon.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I ran just a little 
longer...?
choice_data_list: Dorm curfew is coming up soon.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to enjoy this beautiful night 
view.

Silence Suzuka continued running under the 
starry sky until the very last minute 
allowed on the training track.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? I-Is it that time already...!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I need to run back... Ah, but if I'm able 
to run, does that mean it's fine...?

Silence Suzuka hurriedly ran back to the 
dorm.
